profile_text: Operating in the out-of-home media sector, this Düsseldorf-based firm specializes in providing advertising services on public spaces such as billboards and posters, capitalizing on the growing demand for effective outdoor advertising solutions. With a 63.4% growth rate, the company's success can be attributed to its ability to help businesses reach their target audiences in high-traffic areas. As a result, the company has expanded its workforce to 134 employees in 2024, solidifying its position as a key player in the industry.
